SELECT task.stage_code AS stageCode, COUNT(*) AS taskCount FROM proj_project_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND task.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND task.deleted = b'0' AND GROUP BY task.stage_code ORDER BY task.stage_code

SELECT task.* FROM proj_task_tree_path path JOIN proj_project_task task ON task.tenant_id = path.tenant_id AND task.project_id = path.project_id AND task.id = path.descendant_task_id AND task.deleted = b'0' WHERE path.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND path.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND path.ancestor_task_id = #{query.sourceTaskId} AND path.descendant_task_id <> #{query.sourceTaskId} AND path.deleted = b'0' ORDER BY task.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update:
UPDATE proj_project_task SET name = #{query.name},
business_level_code = #{query.businessLevelCode},
plan_start_time = #{query.planStartTime}, plan_end_time = #{query.planEndTime}, priority = #{query.priority}, sort_order = #{query.sortOrder}, description = #{query.description}, version = version + 1, updater = #{query.updater}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.taskId} AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'
mapper.select: SELECT task.id FROM proj_task_tree_path path JOIN proj_project_task task ON task.tenant_id = path.tenant_id AND task.project_id = path.project_id AND task.id = path.descendant_task_id AND task.deleted = b'0' WHERE path.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND path.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND path.ancestor_task_id = #{query.projectTaskId} AND path.distance > 0 AND path.deleted = b'0' AND (task.status IS NULL OR task.status NOT IN ('DONE', 'CLOSED')) ORDER BY task.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT dependency.predecessor_task_id FROM proj_task_dependency dependency LEFT JOIN proj_project_task predecessor ON predecessor.tenant_id = dependency.tenant_id AND predecessor.project_id = dependency.project_id AND predecessor.id = dependency.predecessor_task_id AND predecessor.deleted = b'0' WHERE dependency.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND dependency.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND dependency.successor_task_id = #{query.projectTaskId} AND dependency.deleted = b'0' AND (predecessor.id IS NULL OR predecessor.status IS NULL OR predecessor.status NOT IN ('DONE', 'CLOSED')) ORDER BY dependency.predecessor_task_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT task.id AS task_id, task.progress, task.estimated_hours, task.status FROM proj_project_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND task.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND task.deleted = b'0' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_task child WHERE child.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND child.project_id = task.project_id AND child.parent_task_id = task.id AND child.deleted = b'0' ) ORDER BY task.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE external_path FROM proj_task_tree_path external_path JOIN proj_task_tree_path subtree ON subtree.tenant_id = external_path.tenant_id AND subtree.project_id = external_path.project_id AND subtree.ancestor_task_id = #{query.taskId} AND subtree.descendant_task_id = external_path.descendant_task_id AND subtree.deleted = b'0' LEFT JOIN proj_task_tree_path internal_ancestor ON internal_ancestor.tenant_id = external_path.tenant_id AND internal_ancestor.project_id = external_path.project_id AND internal_ancestor.ancestor_task_id = #{query.taskId} AND internal_ancestor.descendant_task_id = external_path.ancestor_task_id AND internal_ancestor.deleted = b'0' WHERE external_path.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND external_path.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND external_path.deleted = b'0' AND internal_ancestor.id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO proj_task_tree_path (project_id, ancestor_task_id, descendant_task_id, distance, version, creator, updater, tenant_id) SELECT #{query.projectId}, parent_path.ancestor_task_id, subtree.descendant_task_id, parent_path.distance + subtree.distance + 1, 0, #{query.updater}, #{query.updater}, #{query.tenantId} FROM proj_task_tree_path parent_path JOIN proj_task_tree_path subtree ON subtree.tenant_id = parent_path.tenant_id AND subtree.project_id = parent_path.project_id AND subtree.ancestor_task_id = #{query.taskId} AND subtree.deleted = b'0' WHERE #{query.targetParentTaskId} IS NOT NULL AND parent_path.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND parent_path.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND parent_path.descendant_task_id = #{query.targetParentTaskId} AND parent_path.deleted = b'0'
mapper.update: UPDATE proj_project_task task JOIN proj_task_tree_path subtree ON subtree.tenant_id = task.tenant_id AND subtree.project_id = task.project_id AND subtree.descendant_task_id = task.id AND subtree.ancestor_task_id = #{query.taskId} AND subtree.deleted = b'0' SET task.root_task_id = #{query.newRootTaskId}, task.tree_depth = task.tree_depth + #{query.depthDelta}, task.updater = #{query.updater}, task.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE task.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND task.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND task.id <> #{query.taskId} AND task.deleted = b'0'
